GEORGE CARLIN: Thank you. Thank you very much. [applause]

Somewhere along the way, the used car became a pre-owned vehicle. [laughter] Nobody owned it before. It was pre-owned! Like it was waiting for you. The dump became a landfill. The landfill became a waste management facility. Next year it'll be a memory garden. [laughter]

We don't have poor people anymore. We have the economically disadvantaged. They're still broke, but now they sound like they went to college. [laughter] [applause]

Let's talk about airports. Airports have rules for everything. Please keep your bags with you at all times. Where else would they be? [laughter] Do not joke about security. Folks, the whole building is a joke about security. [laughter]

Ever notice your stuff is always stuff, and other people's stuff is junk? [laughter] That's the whole meaning of life, trying to find a place for your stuff. You buy a bigger house so you can buy more stuff. Then you rent a storage unit for the stuff that didn't fit. [laughter] Thank you, good night!
